Real-time column, specific data, sign-in summarised, hosting removed

Read from each repo's source (MapHub, text/event-stream, PushServiceClient, the auth setup). PoMemeVideo's sign-in was checked on its live site.

What moved

  1. GONE The Hosting column, and the scan code that filled it.
  2. NEW A Real-time column: SignalR (7 apps; PoMiniGames runs 13 hubs), SignalR + WebSockets (PoFightJudge, to GPT-Realtime), Server-sent events (PoSeeReview, PoMode), and Web Push (PoTraffic, PoMode). The hint says what each one carries.

  4. SIGN-IN Moved to the shared strip: "Microsoft, except PoRepoLineTracker: GitHub". PoRepoLineTracker dropped Microsoft sign-in on purpose (it reads GitHub, and a Microsoft login has no GitHub token). PoMemeVideo was confirmed as Microsoft.
  5. RULE To make that possible, a column where every app but one agrees (3+ apps) now moves into the strip and names the exception. The same rule moved the RL table's Frontend: "Unity WebGL, except PoSlapUnreal: Unreal Engine".
  6. EXTRAS SignalR moved from Extras into Real-time; Extras keeps the outside APIs (GitHub, Google Maps, Google Places, Azure email).
